newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 1997 unemployment seen rising to 8.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania 1997 unemployment seen rising to 8.0 pct.

text.p: Romania's unemployment rate is expected to 8.0 percent by end-1997 from 6.1 percent last December, Finance Minister Mircea Ciumara said on Monday.

"We expect an unemployement rate of 8.0 percent this year," Ciumara told a news conference during which Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea set forth the reform package which the centrist colaition government agreed with international lenders.
The rise of unemployment would follow tough government steps to speed up privatisation and restructure the country's communist-era industries.
The jobless rate was 6.7 percent last month.
